statements.statement: The patient presents with a history of palpitations and intermittent lightheadedness
There is concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation and other unspecified cardiac arrhythmias
A mobile cardiac telemetry study (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is for monitoring to capture the frequency and duration of episodic symptoms for appropriate rate and rhythm control management
The diagnoses are I49.9 and I48.91
The denial reason code is PR-204
The service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
The procedure falls outside the contracted policy terms coverage parameters
